Title: Manly deck: TORVUS Eye of Hazimel

Messages.Author: Pyrocuror
Messages.Body:
Hi guys,

I'm doing a rework on a very old school deck played by one of the best players in Paris (Mochud) a few years ago. This guy always played strange deck with his own deckbuilding touch like 10 cap assamites BH with nobounce and shit, and managed to actually win a lot of game with pure technic skills - too bad he almost never played on major tournaments.

Whatever. So this MANVUS deck was one of his fav', and I tried it sometimes but it's very difficult not to die... Lol.

This decks dies turn 5 to DEM bleed, or DOM powerbleed, like 70% of the decks in the game so no need to worry about this - it wont handle a very aggressive predator most of the time. It will, tho, destroy a lot of other slower decks. And it's manly.

The concept is: get eye of hazimel on torvus, bleed, and manage to multi rush.
Built in rush, 3 strenght, 2 bleed, untap ability, 1 less blood on combat cards - sounds good.

I made the deck with a toolboxy touch: some wakes, raven and shit, but the core is rush + destroy. I also built it old school style with a few masters, no villein, pentex and such. 90 cards and 13 masters in order not to jam.

Crypt: (5 cards, Min: 36, Max: 36, Avg: 9)  5 Torvus Bloodbeard pot ANI FOR OBF PRO9 Gangrel
+6 random  low caps guys

Library: (90 cards)  Master (13 cards)
2 Vast Wealth => getting Eye of Hazimel
3 Sudden Reversal => against pentex, temptation of greater power
4 Blood Doll => to pay the eye - if someone vessels your BD, manrush him
1 Carver`s Meat Packing and Storage => manage swarms
2 Fame
1 Monster => more multi-acting possibilities

Action (9 cards)
3 Bum`s Rush
4 Deep Song
2 Harass

Action Modifier (10 cards)
7 Freak Drive
2 Cloak the Gathering => cloaking low caps that bleed to get the edge
1 Veil the Legions

Reaction (6 cards)
2 Cats` Guidance
1 On the Qui Vive
2 Forced Awakening
1 Confusion of the Eye

Combat (44 cards)
8 Carrion Crows
10 Immortal Grapple
6 Skin of Steel
7 Claws of the Dead
7 Taste of Vitae
2 Indomitability
1 Hidden Strength
3 Slam

Retainer (2 cards)
2 Raven Spy

Equipment (3 cards)
3 Eye of Hazimel

Combo (3 cards)
3 Swallowed by the Night

This deck was last saved at 23:37:13 on 04/11/2012

Let me know what you think about this - was wondering if there were not any easier way to handle maneuvers !

Could add an Archon Inv too, maybe some Canine Hordes...

Messages.Author: Pyrocuror
Messages.Body:
Well it would be more manly I must admit.
But that would be a waste considering Torvus special.
There will be a lot of turn where you bleed, act with torvus, burn the edge to untap, then bleed again. So you can get Torvus untap on your prey's turn, for example, by burning the edge during his minion > but with no casual cept it is useless.

There are 2 options:

-Like said Boris, include a master skill+enkil cog module, so Torvus can rush or bleed between turn, using his special to untap

-Play a couple raven and cats like I do

I'd prefer the first solution (it is flat batter) but I don't know if it's reliable. Casual cept is easier to use, and can prove to be a lifesaver.

And thanks for Drawing out the beast, I guess it's the more obvious way to handle this - I hope I still some copies of this card somewhere ... ^^

Messages.Author: Flekk
Messages.Body:

Messages.Author: Azel
Messages.Body:
Go full press + Owl Companion. That way you can conserve your cards, especially against S:CE, and cut back on combat card slots for more oust. Though peeking is seen by some as déclassé.

Combat Setup:
Eye of Hazimel
Owl Companion (S:CE peek)
Spirit of the Beast

Combat Transient:
Carrion Crows (because environmental rocks, and you're gonna sport IG combat trumps anyway)
Drawing Out the Beast (range management, anti-guns, extra non-prevent damage)
Immortal Grapple (the trump)
Flesh of Marble (ignore most hitback)
Claws of the Dead (burn people)
Indomitability, Taste of Vitae, & Skin of Night to taste

Optional:
Street Cred (might as well gain pool, right?)

And that's total overkill, but might as well have fun.

Protean weenies have Sonar, so you can be all manly and say, "Who said that? Why don't you tell me to my face!"
